correctness.rationale: Headline refutation is a complete finite proof, independently replayed from scratch. Auditor decoded Class-69 shadings directly from Fang et al. HTML TikZ (cells (x,y)): pattern1 {(1,2),(1,1),(2,1),(0,0)}, pattern2 {(2,2),(0,1),(1,1),(1,0)}, pattern3 {(0,2),(1,1),(2,1),(1,0)}, pattern4 {(1,2),(0,1),(1,1),(2,0)} — exactly candidate A/B/C/D. Mesh convention (dots at (i,pi_i), shaded cell bottom-left in R, Brandén-Claesson occurrence) matches paper Def 2.1. Auditor's independent checker (no reuse of candidate code) reproduces the n=3 involution table exactly: 123->1,1,2,2; 132->0,2,1,1; 213->2,0,1,1; 321->0,0,0,0, giving avoidance 2 (A/B) vs 1 (C/D) and histograms {0:2,1:1,2:1} vs {0:1,1:2,2:1}. Full S3 distributions coincide ({0:2,1:3,2:1}), so failure is involution-specific. Auditor fully re-enumerated S7 (5040 perms) and all 232 involutions at n=7 with independent code: 4-way S7 agreement {0:1956,1:1690,2:887,3:365,4:120,5:21,6:1} and inv7 split A/B {0:116,1:38,2:45,3:17,4:12,5:3,6:1} vs C/D {0:58,1:64,2:49,3:35,4:19,5:6,6:1} match artifacts exactly; n=4,5,6 spot checks confirm A==B, C==D, A!=C with full-group 4-way agreement. S8/S9 tables are presented only as certified evidence (not proof) with dual counters and avoidance-column replay; DRAFT Sec.5 honestly states full 2019 conjecture remains open. No boundary error: n=3 minimal counterexample suffices to falsify universal equidistribution on involutions.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Fang et al. 2606.14367 (12 Jun 2026) abstract + concluding Conjecture 1 explicitly conjectures Class-69 4-way equidistribution on involutions (first-two/last-two trivially equivalent, 4-way new) and leaves 106/105 and 47/46 hinging on the 2019 full-group conjecture. Su-Kitaev-Zhang 2605.19429 gives prior bounds 105-108 / Wilf<=49 with no involution conjecture and no resolution. No checked source records an involution refutation, n=3 involution tables, or the {A,B} vs {C,D} two-class refinement. Nearest neighbours (POP ordinal/disjoint sums, Cayley insertion encoding) concern different objects. Candidate's n=3 separation plus n=4-9 two-class persistence is therefore new and not mechanically implied by the trivial reverse-complement symmetries (which only give intra-pair equalities).

value.rationale: Headline is an independently retrievable exact fact about a pre-motivated natural object: it falsifies the explicitly posed June-2026 involution analogue for the last open length-2 mesh class and replaces it with the certified refinement {A,B} vs {C,D} (separated already at n=3, avoidance 2 vs 1, widening to 1407 vs 735 at n=9, full histograms tabled). Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the Kitaev/Fu classification program; the value was not known (paper conjectures the opposite) and is not mechanically implied (full-group agreement holds at every n checked, so involution failure is not a corollary). A future researcher needs precisely this minimal witness and the corrected two-class statement to avoid citing a false conjecture. Judged separately from the unfinished S7-S9 full-group survey, which is honestly labeled as evidence-only and does not claim completeness. This satisfies the exact-invariant-of-natural-object clause; certification alone is not doing the work — the pre-posed conjecture and its correction are.
